name: aMule
description: aMule is a free, open-source eD2k and Kad peer-to-peer file-sharing client. This install runs the headless amuled daemon with its bundled amuleapi web interface.

notes.text: Log in to the web UI with the admin password stored in /opt/amule_data/.env.
Forward TCP 4662 and UDP 4672 on your router for eD2k and Kad connectivity.
The web UI serves on port 80; 4712 is loopback-only and used by amulecmd and amulegui.
